BATCH PROCEDURE
N-Diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol (DMAOL; MW 239.32 g/mol) was prepared as a 3.8 wt% solution in methanol. The solution density is assumed to be 0.792 g/mL (approximately 0.126 M DMAOL). A 200 mL charge was contacted with hydrogen over 0.5 g of 7 wt% Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 catalyst in a stirred batch reactor at 60 °C and 21 bar for 5 h. Conversion to 3-azetidinol was 38.1%.
